description: This file implements a SignIn page/component for a web application, providing email/password authentication via Supabase and OAuth options through Google and GitHub. It manages user sign-in flows, displays UI elements, and handles navigation post-authentication.

methods.name: SignIn
methods.description: React functional component for the sign-in page, handling user authentication and rendering UI elements.

methods.name: handleEmailPassword
methods.description: Asynchronous function that attempts to sign in user with given email and password, then navigates based on user role and previous location.
